author: Unidex
body:
Hi there Moderators and Administrators, I would like to tell you the reasons I got banned and why should I get unbanned,
About 1 year ago, I was new to minecraft and I wasn't good at PvP in Minecraft.
There were a lot of hackers playing in the server that time, and I didn't know that hacks were illegal,
I know I was small and I was getting mad from many things, there was a mod that beat me so many times and
looked like a hacker, I made a HUGE mistake and used hacks to kill him, he banned me and I was so sad about it,
for about a whole week I had a bad mood and I told myself that I will never use hacks anymore, and I didn't use hacks after that day.
I really really want to play in the servers again and I also bought a rank (I know it has nothing to do with it but just to show you how much I liked the server). If you will unban me I will never hack you can even put someone to spy on me, I just want to play
again in the server, I believe that after a year you can forgive me and I have no reason to hack again, I got better
in PvP and now I don't rage or get mad from the game. Thank you for your attention and I hope you will understand me.
My Minecraft IGN: xKillConfirmed_ (I was banned as "gilgil52")
Reason I got banned: Hacking
I got banned only once.
